_setup: TWA Digital Asset Links — verifies that staybids.in trusts the Play Store app to handle its URLs without showing the Chrome Custom Tabs URL bar. The package_name + sha256_cert_fingerprints below MUST match the installed app exactly. Add MORE entries to sha256_cert_fingerprints when shipping to production (Play App Signing key SHA-256) so both internal-testing + production builds verify.

_source.package_name: Google Play Console → All apps → StayBid → Package name (verified 2026-05-17)
_source.sha256_cert_fingerprints[0]: Play App Signing key certificate SHA-256 (Console → Protected with Play → Play Store protection → App signing → App signing key certificate). THIS is the key Google re-signs the delivered app with in Production — it hides the Chrome URL bar in the TWA. Provided by owner 2026-07-12.
_source.sha256_cert_fingerprints[1]: Upload key certificate SHA-256 (same App signing page). Kept so builds signed with the upload key (e.g. internal-test / direct APK installs) also verify.
_source.sha256_cert_fingerprints[2]: Original internal-test certificate SHA-256 (added 2026-05-17). Retained for backward compatibility with any older installs.
